test_metadata.title: IMS IDLE MO Call_IMS subscriber on home network (VoLTE To VoLTE)[Originating Party terminates the call] - check local ringing
test_metadata.objective:
Two UEs are ready.
HSS should have the subscriber's information. 
Both UEs can support IP connectivity and IMS profile configuration.                                                                                       
LTE cell (Cell A with IMS VoPS=1 -> IMS supported)
UE B is powered up and IMS registered 
DUT is switched off.

prerequisites.route: UK: Hartley Whitney; ITA: Desk location

execution_procedure.instruction: 1)DUT is powered on and completes IMS registration on a LTE cell (Cell A with IMS VoPS=1 -> IMS supported)
2) Initiate MO voice call from the DUT to the target destination (IMS subscriber on home network - i.e. powered up UE B on VoLTE coverage)
3) Check that the DUT plays the correct local ring tone
4) Answer the call from UE B
5) Do some DTMF tones
6) End the voice call from the DUT after 20 seconds
7) DUT returns to RRC idle state

checks: Examine UE logs from the DUT to establish:
1) That the DUT completes IMS registration.
2) That the DUT established a VoLTE call to UE B
3) Verify that the DUT played the correct local ring tone  while establishing the call to UE B.
4) No noticable issue with voice quality
5) DTMF tones are generated and they are all heard on the DUT
6) All steps under test procedure are successfully executed, and the DUT returns to RRC idle state after the test is completed.
ITA requirements: Report the call setup time and the speech code used
expected_result.pass_when: The field procedure is completed and the system call log agrees with the call that was placed or received.

test_metadata.title: SRVCC EUTRAN to UTRAN Handover

execution_procedure.instruction: • DUT: dial a voice call to UE-1.
• UE-1: answer the call.

• DUT initiates SRVCC handover from EUTRAN to UTRAN by moving away from EUTRAN coverage to UTRAN coverage

• Verify that Handover from EUTRAN to UTRAN is successful
• All steps under test procedure are successfully executed, and the DUT returns to RRC idle state after the test is completed.
expected_result.pass_when: The field procedure is completed and the system call log agrees with the call that was placed or received.

test_metadata.title: SRVCC EUTRAN to UTRAN with PS HO Support
test_metadata.objective:
1) DUT and UE-1 are connected and registered to an IMS network. LTE cell with VoPS=1
2) DUT and Network supports SRVCC

execution_procedure.instruction: 1) DUT: Connect to a known FTP Server using an FTP client or using DOS command
2) DUT: Download a sizeable file from the ftp server
3) DUT: Whilst  the FTP download is in progress, Initiate a voice call to UE-1
4) UE-1 : answer the call and voice call in progress
5) Move the DUT away from EUTRAN coverage location to trigger Handover to 3G
6) Network: initiate SRVCC handover of DUT from E-UTRAN to UTRAN.
7) DUT: wait for the PS Download to finish before ending the voice call

checks: 1) PS Call established and in progress
2) The voice call is established and in progress
3) Verify that Handover from EUTRAN to UTRAN is successful and that both the PS transfer and voice call are still in progress following the SRVCC Handover.
4) Verify all call flow and call set up are correct in the Log
5) All steps under test procedure are successfully executed, and the DUT returns to RRC idle state after the test is completed.
expected_result.pass_when: The field procedure is completed and the system call log agrees with the call that was placed or received.

test_metadata.title: SRVCC EUTRAN to UTRAN while in ringing
test_metadata.objective:
1) DUT and UE-1 are connected and registered to an IMS network. LTE cell with VoPS=1
2) DUT and Network supports SRVCC

execution_procedure.instruction: 1) DUT: Connect to a known FTP Server using an FTP client or using DOS command
2) DUT: Download a sizeable file from the ftp server
3) DUT: Whilst  the FTP download is in progress, Initiate a voice call to UE-1
4) Do not answer the call, so ringing is in progress
5) Move the DUT away from EUTRAN coverage location to trigger Handover to 3G
6) Network: initiate SRVCC handover of DUT from E-UTRAN to UTRAN.
7) ANSWER CALL AFTER SRVCC COMPLETED
8) DUT: wait for the PS Download to finish before ending the voice call

checks: 1) PS Call established and in progress
2) The voice call is established and in progress
3) Verify that Handover from EUTRAN to UTRAN is successful and that both the PS transfer and voice call are still in progress following the SRVCC Handover.
4) Verify all call flow and call set up are correct in the Log
5) All steps under test procedure are successfully executed, and the DUT returns to RRC idle state after the test is completed.
expected_result.pass_when: The field procedure is completed and the system call log agrees with the call that was placed or received.

test_metadata.title: Communication Hold

4) DUT puts UE-1 on hold and answered calls from UE-2
5) DUT finished the voice call with UE-2 and disconnects the call
6) DUT resumes call with UE-1
7) DUT hangs the call from UE-1

checks: 1) Check active voice call in progress between DUT and UE-1
2) Speech is not present in UE-1 whilst on hold
3) Check UE-1 is on hold.
4) Ensure 2-way audio is present between DUT and UE-1
5) Ensure that the DUT resume call with UE-1
6) Verify  Media exchange (IMS/SIP) message sequence

test_metadata.title: VoLTE Long Call Mobility
test_metadata.objective: The purpose of this test is to verify that the DUT can successfully perform mobility with handovers during a long time and sustain a VoLTE call.

execution_procedure.instruction: Prerequiste
• DUT has performed a VoLTE Attach and registered to IMS network.
• There must be a sufficient number of E-UTRAN cells available on the same LTE frequency layer to permit multiple handovers during a VoLTE call.
Steps
• Initiate an MO voice call from the DUT to UE-1
• Move between the coverage areas of different cells on a test route
• Leave the call in progress for at least 1 hour

checks: • The DUT should be connected without losing service
• DUT must not drop the call
• All steps under test procedure are successfully executed, and the DUT returns to RRC idle state after the test is completed.
expected_result.pass_when: The field procedure is completed and the system call log agrees with the call that was placed or received.

test_metadata.title: PS Data (FTP Upload), MT Voice Call with PS Data Released first
test_metadata.objective: To demonstrate that the DUT and the network should perform a MultiRAB scenario as expected.

execution_procedure.instruction: Prerequiste
• DUT has performed a PS attach and setup a PDN connection in the LTE network.
• DUT has performed an IMS/SIP registration
• DUT is powered ON and in IDLE
Steps
• DUT Initiate PS Data and Upload a large file (e.g. with FTP)
• DUT: Whilst data call is in progress, establish Voice call from UE-1 to DUT
• Monitor the data flow ensuring that there is no disconnection issues
• DUT: wait for the data transfer to finish before ending the voice call
• DUT: Deactivate the PS connection after FTP Data has been completed.

checks: • Verify that the speech call continues and the speech quality is undisturbed.
• Verify that data call continues and the data stream is not interrupted
• Ensure that the DUT does not drop the voice call
• All steps under test procedure are successfully executed, and the DUT returns to RRC idle state after the test is completed.
• Verify stability of the device during and after test completes
expected_result.pass_when: The field procedure is completed and the system call log agrees with the call that was placed or received.
